{"cc":[{"text":"Patient presents for callus care. Mentions some general foot
discomfort and is doing more standing at his new job.","start_char":47,"end_char":136}],"hpi":[{"text":"47-year-old male with no significant past medical history presents
with a chronic painful callus on the right plantar second metatarsal
head, last debrided three months ago. The callus has rebuilt and is
causing discomfort with weight bearing. Patient also notes that he
recently changed jobs and is now standing on concrete floors most of
the day; his feet feel "tired" and "achy" by end of shift. No specific
location of pain identified, no swelling, no acute injury. He has tried
gel insoles but feels they aren't helping.","start_char":143,"end_char":466}],"exam_findings":[{"text":"Right foot: discrete callus at the plantar second metatarsal head,
approximately 6mm diameter, central nucleation. No ulceration. Skin
otherwise intact. Pedal pulses +2, no edema. Patient demonstrated
walking pattern in clinic; gait unremarkable. Non-tender along plantar
fascia, Achilles, midfoot, or forefoot otherwise. Footwear inspected:
he is wearing flat work shoes with minimal arch support.
Left foot: skin intact, no comparable callus, no other findings.","start_char":479,"end_char":764}],"mdm":[{"text":"Right plantar second metatarsal head intractable plantar keratoma
meets indication for routine paring given recurrence pattern and pain
with weight bearing. Patient also reports general foot fatigue from
new job; counseled on supportive footwear with arch support and
recommended he try over-the-counter cushioned insoles. If symptoms
persist, recommend follow-up to evaluate for biomechanical
contributors. Continue periodic paring as needed.","start_char":777,"end_char":1054}],"procedure_note":[{"text":"Following informed consent: right plantar second metatarsal head
intractable keratoma was pared using sterile technique. Hyperkeratotic
tissue removed sharply. No bleeding. Patient reports immediate relief.","start_char":1066,"end_char":1224}],"ambiguous_segments":[]}
